Alert PRH-AUTH-007 (medium): Failed sign-ins for many accounts from one network

recommended_actions: Rate-limit or challenge sign-ins from the network while you investigate.
Make the affected account owners reset their passwords if any of them signed in from it.
For the web app, enforce two-step verification and reject common passwords.
limitations: Single log source (app-security): no other log corroborates it
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-007: A large office, school or carrier-grade NAT where many people share one network
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-007: A company-wide password reset or a sign-in outage that makes many users fail at once
